usage: agentbreeder services logs [-h] [--tail N] [--since D] [--follow]
                                  [--json] [--level {warning,error}] [--raw]
                                  [DIR] NAME [[DIR] NAME ...]

positional arguments:
  [DIR] NAME

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --tail N              The last N lines (default 200, at most 10000)
  --since D             Only lines since D (10m, 2h, 2026-11-11T09:00:00Z)
  --follow              Keep printing new lines until the service stops,
                        Ctrl-C, SIGTERM, SIGHUP or the end of a non-terminal
                        stdin
  --json                Print the result as JSON
  --level {warning,error}
                        Only records at this level or above, for a known log
                        format (a heuristic; continuation lines stay with
                        their record)
  --raw                 Print control characters as they are (unsafe; --json
                        always escapes)
